artifact.name: xUnit
artifact.whenToUse: When writing or changing tests in a .NET project that uses xUnit.
artifact.body:
## Writing the test

One assertion per behaviour. Name the test for the behaviour, not the method.

## Verifying it

Run `dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName~<TestName>` and read the output. A test that has not been run is not a test that passes; report the counts you saw.
